description: For an AGENCY with GoHighLevel connected: search its own GoHighLevel contacts by name, email, phone or company. Returns each contact's id, email, phone, tags and whether they're on Do Not Disturb. Use it to get the right contact id before ghl_send_sms or ghl_send_email, and to check with the agency that it's the right person.

query.description: Name, email, phone or company to search for.

name: ghl_find_contacts
title: Find contacts in my GoHighLevel
